{"script":"set -euo pipefail
ws=cpu_check_workspace
mkdir -p "$ws"
# 1. timestamp
date --utc +%FT%T%Z > "$ws/timestamp.txt"
# 2. system_info.raw
{
  uname -a
  cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || true
  lsb_release -a 2>/dev/null || true
  hostnamectl 2>/dev/null || true
} > "$ws/system_info.raw"
# 3. hardware_listing.raw
{
  lshw -short 2>/dev/null || true
  dmidecode -t processor 2>/dev/null || true
  lscpu 2>/dev/null || true
  cat /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || true
  lspci -vv 2>/dev/null || true
} > "$ws/hardware_listing.raw"
# 4. processors_extracted.txt
grep -iE 'processor|cpu' "$ws/hardware_listing.raw" > "$ws/processors_extracted.txt" || true
# 5. cpu_identifiers.txt and logical_counts.tmp
# Try to extract canonical 'processor : N' entries from the hardware listing
grep -oP '(?i)(?<=processor\s*:\s*)\d+' "$ws/hardware_listing.raw" > "$ws/cpu_identifiers.txt" || true
if [ ! -s "$ws/cpu_identifiers.txt" ]; then
  grep -oP '(?i)(?<=processor\s*:\s*)\d+' /proc/cpuinfo > "$ws/cpu_identifiers.txt" || true
fi
wc -l < "$ws/cpu_identifiers.txt" | awk '{print $1}' > "$ws/logical_counts.tmp"
# 6. virtualization_check.txt
if grep -qiE 'hypervisor|virtual|kvm|vmware|docker|lxc|container|kubepods|microsoft' "$ws/system_info.raw"; then
  grep -iE 'hypervisor|virtual|kvm|vmware|docker|lxc|container|kubepods|microsoft' "$ws/system_info.raw" > "$ws/virtualization_check.txt"
else
  echo "No virtualization/container indicators found in system_info.raw" > "$ws/virtualization_check.txt"
fi
# 7. consistency_report.txt
grep -oP '(?i)(?<=processor\s*:\s*)\d+' "$ws/processors_extracted.txt" | sort -n > "$ws/tmp_ids_proc.txt" || true
sort -n "$ws/cpu_identifiers.txt" > "$ws/tmp_ids_cpu.txt" || true
comm -3 "$ws/tmp_ids_proc.txt" "$ws/tmp_ids_cpu.txt" > "$ws/consistency_diff.txt" || true
{
  echo "Count_cpu_identifiers=$(cat $ws/logical_counts.tmp 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  echo "Count_processors_extracted=$(wc -l < \"$ws/tmp_ids_proc.txt\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  if [ -s "$ws/consistency_diff.txt" ]; then
    echo "Mismatches/differences between extracted processor ids and cpu identifiers:"
    cat "$ws/consistency_diff.txt"
  else
    echo "No mismatches detected between processors_extracted.txt and cpu_identifiers.txt"
  fi
} > "$ws/consistency_report.txt"
# 8. runtime snapshot if mismatches
if [ -s "$ws/consistency_diff.txt" ]; then
  { uptime; top -bn1 | head -n 20; } > "$ws/runtime_snapshot.txt"
  echo "" >> "$ws/consistency_report.txt"
  echo "Runtime snapshot appended in runtime_snapshot.txt" >> "$ws/consistency_report.txt"
fi
# 9. package archive and verification
tar -C "$ws" -cf /tmp/archive_prepared.tar . || true
mv /tmp/archive_prepared.tar "$ws/archive_prepared.tar" || true
sha256sum "$ws/archive_prepared.tar" > "$ws/archive_verification.txt" || true
# 10. final_prep_summary.txt
{
  echo "Timestamp: $(cat $ws/timestamp.txt)"
  echo "Logical processor count (from cpu_identifiers.txt): $(cat $ws/logical_counts.tmp)"
  echo "CPU identifiers sample (first 10):"
  head -n 10 "$ws/cpu_identifiers.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo ""
  echo "Files archived: $(ls -1 $ws | tr '\n' ',' )"
} > "$ws/final_prep_summary.txt"
# output the final authoritative cpu count
cat "$ws/logical_counts.tmp"
"}
